backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Pristine Learning backend, defining data types (bookings, reviews, users, teachers, withdrawals) and persistent storage maps, with Stripe payment integration, access control, and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the fix for the SubscriptionPackagesPage bug where subscriptions were activated without Stripe payment confirmation, mapping the fix to test ID REQ-61.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and notable changes or fixes.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark theme color system used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'Pristine Learning' and mounting the React root at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application file configuring TanStack Router with all page routes, alias redirects for legacy paths, a shared RootLayout with Navbar/Footer, and React Query setup.
frontend/src/components/BookingModal.tsx: Modal component for booking demo or paid sessions with a teacher, generating time slots for the next 5 days, saving bookings to local store, and sending notifications to both student and teacher.
Provides a responsive dashboard shell with role-based sidebar navigation (admin/teacher/student), notification badge, and logout functionality using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/DemoModeBanner.t: Displays a dismissible amber banner warning users they are in admin demo mode, with an option to exit and clear demo data.
frontend/src/components/DemoModeButton.t: Renders a button to enter admin demo mode by seeding local demo data and navigating to the admin dashboard without requiring authentication.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site-wide footer with branding, quick links, support links, contact email, social icons, and a localized copyright line.
frontend/src/components/MessageInbox.tsx: Two-panel messaging UI that lists conversations and displays messages for the selected conversation, with real-time polling and a send mutation backed by a local store.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop and mobile menus, Internet Identity login/logout, language switcher, and active-link highlighting.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that collects a new user's full name and email to create their profile, skipping itself in demo mode and calling onComplete after a successful save.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays an aggregate star rating summary and a list of individual reviews for a given teacher, fetching data from the local reviews store via React Query.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSubmission: A form component that lets a student submit a star rating and optional text review for a completed booking, storing the review in the local reviews store.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A dialog for admins to configure Stripe payment integration by entering a secret key and managing a list of allowed country codes, saving the config via the backend actor.
A modal panel that shows detailed profile information, performance metrics, and activity logs for a selected user, supporting both real and demo user data.
frontend/src/components/UserManagementTa: An admin tab component that lists all users with search and filter controls, and opens a UserDetailPanel when a user row is selected, supporting both live backend data and demo mode.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyAnalyticsT: React component that displays weekly platform analytics (users, sessions, revenue, subscriptions) as summary cards and a bar chart, with support for demo mode and snapshot generation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, activity logs, performance metrics, and weekly snapshots, with demo mode fallbacks using seeded data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimezone.ts: Small hook that memoizes the user's local timezone and its abbreviation using the Intl API.
frontend/src/i18n/en.ts: English translation strings for the entire frontend, organized by feature area (navbar, footer, homepage, teacher search, etc.).
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Re-exports the English and Tamil translation objects and the TranslationKeys type from their respective modules.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageContext.tsx: Provides a React context and LanguageProvider for switching between English and Tamil translations, with localStorage persistence and nested key lookup with English fallback.
frontend/src/i18n/ta.ts: Tamil (ta) language translation file for the Pristine Learning platform, containing localized strings for navbar, footer, homepage sections, and other UI components.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for the teal+amber color palette (light and dark modes), and declares reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Local storage utility module defining TypeScript interfaces and CRUD helpers for client-side persistence of bookings, notifications, messages, reviews, blog posts, subscriptions, wallet entries, and referral codes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed sections for managing bookings, withdrawals, users, analytics, and other platform data, supporting both live and demo modes with seed data.
AI Study Assistant page component that provides curriculum-specific study materials, quizzes, and study plans, with detailed pre-generated content for Tamil Nadu Samacheer Kalvi subjects like Mathematics and Science.
frontend/src/pages/BlogListingPage.tsx: Displays a grid of published blog posts fetched from the local store, with cover images, metadata, and navigation to individual post pages. Includes a footer with branding.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders a single blog post by slug with a simple line-by-line markdown parser, showing cover image, author, date, and content. Shows a 404 state if the post is not found.
frontend/src/pages/DemoPage.tsx: Interactive multi-step demo walkthrough showcasing platform features (teacher search, profiles, dashboards, payments) with illustrated slides and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Homepage.tsx: Marketing landing page with a hero section, platform stats, feature highlights, how-it-works steps, and featured teacher cards, linking to search and demo pages.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page that reads an error message from URL params and displays it with options to retry or return home, noting no charges were made.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that verifies a Stripe session ID via the actor, activates the matching subscription in local store, and shows a loading or confirmation state.
frontend/src/pages/SessionRecordingsPage: Displays a student's completed session recordings, splitting them into sessions with and without recording URLs, with playback links and a prompt to book if none exist.
frontend/src/pages/StudentDashboard.tsx: Student dashboard showing upcoming/completed bookings, pending reviews, subscription status, referral link, and a message inbox, with a profile setup gate for new users.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPackagesP: Renders available subscription packages and handles checkout via Stripe, with a demo-mode bypass that activates a subscription locally without payment.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Teacher dashboard displaying upcoming/completed bookings, wallet balance, demo slot creation, referral link, and a message inbox, with a profile setup gate for new users.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherProfilePage.ts: Public teacher profile page showing bio, ratings, available demo slots, and reviews, with actions to book a session or start a message conversation.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherSearchPage.tsx: A page that lists and filters teacher profiles by search query, subject, language, and rating, with loading/error states and navigation to individual teacher profiles.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherWalletPage.tsx: A dashboard page for teachers to view their wallet balance, earnings history, and submit withdrawal requests stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/formatTime.ts: Utility functions to format timestamps or ISO strings into localized date/time strings and extract timezone abbreviations using the Intl API.
frontend/src/utils/seedDemoData.ts: Seeds localStorage with demo data (users, bookings, reviews, messages, subscriptions, activity logs, metrics, and weekly snapshots) for admin demo sessions, running only once per session.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the full project state for 'Pristine Learning', a global tutoring marketplace, including architecture notes, known bugs, and a versioned list of implemented features across the Next.js/Node.js/PostgreSQL stack.
